notes.text: The Psalm 9 unit, digitally numbered 643:9, directly transmits the complete account and the demand for their blood.
The narrative has Ben Kupya take the role of judge. The substitute is unspecified, and the outcome should not be assigned to a named additional person.
Heilprin foregrounds the new decree against Ben Kupya; the digital Yalkut says the government decreed both their deaths. The two figures are named in the Yalkut’s frame.
